name: Short-Term Residence Permit (property ownership)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires ownership of real estate in Georgia valued at more than USD 150,000.

evidence_required.document: Property title deed and valuation showing >USD 150,000

sources.title: Legislative Herald of Georgia (matsne.gov.ge) -- Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 15(j)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Georgia's initial build. This is a genuinely lower-tier, distinct legal status from ge_investment_residence_permit (Article 15(h), USD 300,000, 5 years, leads onward to permanent status) -- this one (Article 15(j)) is a smaller USD 150,000 property threshold, renewable only annually, and the sda.gov.ge source does not describe it as leading toward permanent/unlimited residence the way the larger investment permit does -- kept separate rather than merged, per this dataset's principle of not collapsing genuinely different named legal statuses into one file. leads_to_pr set false: not described as counting toward Article 15(g)'s 10-year track or Article 15(k)'s 5-year investment track in the sources fetched -- an honest gap, not assumed.
